purpose: Freeze real host projects and their official integration surfaces for augmentation and replacement experiments. Interface adapters must be generated by the platform, not supplied by the experimenter.

correction.invalid_prior_interpretation: PyOD, StatsForecast, OR-Tools, invoice2data, Haystack, and Evidently were treated as the six real projects.
correction.correct_interpretation: Those repositories are component candidates. A real-project experiment intervenes in a host application with an existing user workflow, official interface, baseline, and rollback boundary.

experimenter_may_supply: official machine-readable schemas or protocol examples
independent oracle, load generator, and fault proxy
experimenter_must_not_supply: plugin that already completes the target task
manual patch counted as automatic delivery

host_projects.name: Paperless-ngx
official_surfaces: document consumption workflow triggers and actions
host_projects.augmentation_candidate: invoice extraction, deterministic validation, exception review, metadata writeback, and accounting artifact
host_projects.replacement_candidate: deterministic or automatic metadata matching while preserving Paperless document metadata contracts

host_projects.name: InvenTree
official_surfaces: event, schedule, validation, notification, and URL plugin mixins
host_projects.augmentation_candidate: forecast-driven replenishment recommendation and approved purchase-order writeback
host_projects.replacement_candidate: low-stock notification and order-issuance flow with original threshold semantics or a separately reported predictive stack

host_projects.name: ThingsBoard
official_surfaces: Rule Engine messages, nodes, and chains
external REST nodes and rule-chain import/export
host_projects.augmentation_candidate: telemetry quality, anomaly detection, governed maintenance alarm, and work-order writeback
host_projects.replacement_candidate: a frozen validation, transformation, alarm, and REST-writeback rule-chain segment

host_projects.name: Actual Budget
host_projects.augmentation_candidate: receipt extraction, transaction matching, exception review, and evidence writeback
host_projects.replacement_candidate: ordered transaction categorization rules while preserving import and deduplication invariants
host_projects.qualification_note: This host intentionally tests whether the platform can bridge an SDK or CLI instead of assuming every integration is REST.

host_projects.name: Chatwoot
host_projects.license: MIT-Expat outside enterprise and third-party directories
host_projects.augmentation_candidate: intent and urgency triage, evidence-grounded reply candidate, human approval, and writeback
host_projects.replacement_candidate: frozen routing, labeling, and assignment automation rules

host_projects.name: Home Assistant Core
official_surfaces: events, states, service actions, and automation triggers
host_projects.augmentation_candidate: energy anomaly and forecast notification with governed device action
host_projects.replacement_candidate: durable door-open timer automation across host restart or automation reload
host_projects.qualification_note: Official trigger documentation states that a for wait is reset by restart or automation reload, creating a concrete reliability comparison.

interface_gap_taxonomy: IF-01 interface material ingestion and integration-point discovery
IF-02 OpenAPI and JSON Schema import
IF-04 authentication and Secret Store mapping
IF-10 pagination, rate limits, and asynchronous jobs
IF-13 connector version and evidence registry
IF-14 interface diagnostics and automatic repair
claim_boundary: Official-interface qualification does not prove that the host project runs in the local experiment environment.
No host baseline, platform-generated connector, augmentation, or replacement has passed yet.
A component probe cannot be counted as a host-project delivery result.
Any experimenter-written adapter makes automatic_interface_alignment false.
